source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia — Tiskové centrum
why_relevant: Cross-border CZ/SK entity; its press centre covers appointments affecting both markets and hosts an economists' section whose bylines reveal senior analyst hires and departures. Note the site is bilingual with mirrored /cs/ and /en/ paths.

source_name: Trinity Bank — Pro média / Tiskové zprávy
why_relevant: Smaller Czech-owned bank with a dated, well-populated press-release stream (multiple releases per quarter) and a named press contact (press@trinitybank.cz). Small banks announce senior hires proportionally more prominently, so signal density per release is high.

source_name: Partners Banka — press/news section (newsroom-style article pages)
why_relevant: Newest CZ retail bank. Confirmed to publish leadership changes as standalone slug pages — e.g. 'Změna ve vedení Partners Banky — novým CEO banky bude Petr Borkovec', naming the outgoing CEO (Marek Ditz), the effective date (1 Feb 2026), a new vice-chair (Tomáš Kořínek) and a promoted board member (Hanka Wallenfelsová) with her Daily Banking/payments remit. Exactly the reporting-line detail aggregators drop.

source_name: Banka CREDITAS — corporate site / press section
why_relevant: Fast-growing domestic group whose leadership changes are real signals (new CEO and deputy board chair Eva Collardová effective 1 July, promoted from group CFO; broader group-wide reshuffle). The bank's own site is the primary carrier; secondary media reproduce only fragments.

source_name: Global Payments Česko — corporate site (acquiring / payment institution)
why_relevant: Extends the cell beyond banks to payment institutions: the largest card-acquiring player in CZ. Its Czech site carries company and contact pages; leadership items appear sparsely and often only via ČTK Protext distribution, which is itself worth tracking as the issuer-controlled channel.

source_name: Worldline Česká republika — country site (payment institution)
why_relevant: Pan-European PSP with a Czech-localised site (cs-cz / en-cz mirrors). Country-level appointments and org changes for the CZ market appear here or on the global newsroom; the cs-cz mirror is the local-language entry point for CZ-specific announcements.

source_name: ČTK Protext — issuer-paid press-release distribution (CZ)
why_relevant: Where CZ banks and payment institutions push press releases verbatim when they have no strong newsroom of their own (confirmed carrying a Global Payments release with a 'Vedení společnosti' section). Acts as a cross-issuer pointer feed that surfaces newsroom URLs and actors this cell would otherwise miss.

source_name: Peníze.cz — bank leadership-change coverage (aggregator/pointer)
source_subtype: trade/consumer finance media + per-bank entity pages
why_relevant: Consistently reports CZ bank board changes ('Změna v představenstvu České spořitelny', 'Creditas má nové vedení', 'Česká spořitelna má nového člena představenstva') and maintains per-bank entity pages. Best used as a detector that a press release exists, then follow to the issuer newsroom for the full text.

source_name: Forbes.cz / Hospodářské noviny (archiv.hn.cz) — executive-move business press (pointer)
why_relevant: Carries the interpretation layer around bank leadership moves (why a CEO left, who the owner favours) and occasionally the talent-pipeline story — e.g. HN on Česká spořitelna's board-shadowing talent programme, which is a hiring/organisation signal with no press-release equivalent.

source_name: NEN – Národní elektronický nástroj (national e-procurement platform)
why_relevant: Mandatory e-procurement system for central state authorities and their subordinate organisations since 1 July 2018 (gov. resolution 408/2018). Tender documentation for banking/payment services names the contracting authority's contact person, project owner and often the responsible department/unit — a direct read on which state unit owns a payments programme and when a new unit appears.

source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (new VVZ on NIPEZ)
why_relevant: Official Czech public procurement journal. Its search form supports contracting authority, IČO, CPV, contract type, winner name and winner IČO — so it yields both the state buyer and the supplier ecosystem for banking/payment contracts. Award notices are the earliest public trace of a new payments programme and its owning unit.

source_name: Registr smluv (Czech contract register, smlouvy.gov.cz)
why_relevant: Statutory register: obliged public bodies must publish contracts within 30 days of conclusion. Full contract PDFs name signatories, contract managers, and the organisational unit responsible — the richest public naming of state-side payments project owners. Administered by DIA since 1 April 2023 (Act 471/2022).

source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU procurement notices)
why_relevant: Above-threshold Czech banking/payment tenders must be published EU-wide. TED gives structured, machine-readable notices filterable by CPV (66110000 banking services, 66172000 financial transaction processing), NUTS CZ, authority and winner — the cleanest cross-checkable feed for state payments buying and the supplier side.

source_name: Hlídač státu – contracts & tenders aggregator with API
why_relevant: NGO aggregator that normalises Registr smluv, Věstník/VVZ, subsidies and company registers into one searchable base with a documented API. Best single entry point for cross-source snowballing: from a payments contract to the supplier, its other state customers, and the named officials.

source_name: Portál o veřejných zakázkách (portal-vz.cz) – MMR methodology & NIPEZ hub
why_relevant: Ministry for Regional Development's methodological hub for NIPEZ/NEN/VVZ. Explains which systems are mandatory for whom and where each authority's buyer profile lives — the map you need before scraping, and it announces structural changes to the procurement systems themselves.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – profil zadavatele & veřejné zakázky pages
why_relevant: The single most important state buyer for banking/treasury/payments in CZ (IČO 00006947, VVZ profile ID 508241). The page resolves which profile is live (NEN /profil/mfcr since 1.7.2018) versus legacy E-ZAK, and MF tender documents name the sponsoring department for Státní pokladna and payment projects.

source_name: Otevřená data Ministerstva financí – seznam smluv MF ČR
why_relevant: MF's own open-data catalogue publishes a tabular list of its valid and invalid contracts — a lighter, structured alternative to scraping Registr smluv for this one high-value buyer, and it exposes contract counterparties in the payments/banking supplier ecosystem.

source_name: SPCSS – Státní pokladna Centrum sdílených služeb, s.p. (career + corporate site)
why_relevant: State enterprise created to deliver the MF ICT strategy — eGovernment cloud, cybersecurity, data centres underpinning Státní pokladna. Its vacancy list is a direct A5 hiring signal: role titles reveal which platforms and units are being staffed up, and management pages reveal leadership changes.

source_name: ISoSS – Informační systém o státní službě (civil-service vacancy portal)
why_relevant: All announced selection procedures for vacant civil-service posts (služební místa) across ministries and agencies are published here. Announcements state the exact department, section and superior post — the canonical, statutory feed for public-sector hiring and for detecting newly created units at MF, ČSSZ, DIA, Finanční/Celní správa.

source_name: ČSSZ – oznámení o vyhlášení výběrového řízení (documents section)
why_relevant: The Czech Social Security Administration is one of the largest state payment originators (pension and benefit disbursement) and a major ICT buyer. Its published selection-procedure PDFs name the department (e.g. data-centre unit) and the superior post — a fine-grained org-change signal.

source_name: Digitální a informační agentura (DIA) – kariéra & org structure
why_relevant: Central authority for eID, trust services and public-sector information systems since 1 April 2023; also now the administrator of Registr smluv. Its career page publishes the org structure alongside vacancies (including senior posts such as deputy director with pay grade), giving both hiring and leadership-move signals for the state digital-payments interface layer.

source_name: ISVS.CZ – eGovernment news site with a state-IT vacancy column
why_relevant: Trade outlet covering Czech public-sector information systems that republishes and comments on state-IT vacancies (e.g. 'Digitální a informační agentura hledá:'). Useful as an early-warning and editorial layer that flags which state units are staffing up, including payment/eGov platform teams.

source_name: Vhodné uveřejnění – buyer profiles & procurement commentary
why_relevant: Hosts buyer profiles for many authorities (incl. a Ministerstvo financí profile page) and publishes explainers on what VVZ vs. profil zadavatele vs. e-tržiště actually contain — a practical map of where a given authority's payment tenders are published when they are not in NEN.

source_name: Tender Arena – certified e-procurement tool & buyer profiles
why_relevant: One of the certified electronic tools (alongside NEN, E-ZAK, JOSEPHINE) used by ministries and municipalities that are not on NEN. Needed for completeness: a payments tender from a municipal or subordinate buyer may only appear here plus in VVZ.

source_name: E-ZAK Ministerstvo financí ČR (legacy buyer profile archive)
why_relevant: MF's pre-1.7.2018 buyer profile, still completing procurements started there. Historical baseline for who ran which payment/banking procurement before the NEN migration — useful for tracing career paths of named project owners over a decade.

source_name: Celní správa ČR – card acceptance at customs offices
why_relevant: The Customs Administration operates its own payment terminals for duties, taxes and administrative fees, with published operating rules (per-terminal daily caps, one income type per terminal). Announcements of terminal rollouts imply a supplier contract and an owning operational unit — an indirect but concrete public-sector acquiring signal.

source_name: Finanční správa ČR – placení daní / payment-service procurement statements
why_relevant: The tax administration has publicly discussed a tender to select a payment-card service provider and the pricing-model obstacle (percentage-of-turnover unacceptable at tax volumes). Q&A and CESOP pages also expose the payment-data reporting regime — both signal where a payments programme and its owning unit sit.

source_name: Česká pošta, s.p. – career portal (tvojebudoucnost.jobs.cz)
why_relevant: State-owned enterprise with ~33,000 employees and the counter network through which ČSOB/Poštovní spořitelna financial and payment products are distributed. Vacancy titles in financial-services and branch-network roles are a proxy for changes in the postal-banking interface; senior/ICT postings signal reorganisation.

source_name: Vláda ČR – výběrová řízení (civil service portal, státní služba section)
why_relevant: Government Office listing of civil-service selection procedures, and the authoritative explanation of the process (announcement on the úřední deska + publication in ISoSS). Provides the rulebook needed to interpret vacancy notices as org-change evidence rather than routine churn.

source_name: Portál gov.cz – service pages for NEN, Registr smluv, VVZ, ISoSS
why_relevant: Canonical service catalogue that resolves the current official URL, administrator and legal basis of each register in this cell — the safest way to detect when a register is moved or re-hosted (e.g. Registr smluv moving from MV to DIA), which otherwise looks like a dead link.
